commands.sf100_q10_q11: env VIBESPATIAL_STRICT_NATIVE=1 uv run python -m benchmarks.spatialbench.run_benchmark --data-dir /home/picard/datasets/spatialbench/v0.1.0/sf100-geoparquet --engines vibespatial --queries q10,q11 --timeout 1200 --runs 1 --warmup-runs 0 --statistic median --output benchmark_results/work_amplification/2026-08-25-r3/sf100_q10_q11_final_lean_cold1.json --scale-factor 100 --result-dir benchmark_results/work_amplification/2026-08-25-r3/results_sf100_q10_q11_final
commands.shootout_10k: uv run vsbench shootout benchmarks/shootout --scale 10K --repeat 3 --reuse-geopandas benchmark_results/work_amplification/2026-08-25-r2/shootout_10k_final.json --timeout 300 --profile-mode off --json --output benchmark_results/work_amplification/2026-08-25-r3/shootout_10k_final.json
commands.shootout_1m: env VIBESPATIAL_STRICT_NATIVE=1 uv run vsbench shootout benchmarks/shootout --scale 1M --repeat 1 --no-warmup --baseline-python /bin/true --timeout 1200 --profile-mode off --json --output benchmark_results/work_amplification/2026-08-25-r3/shootout_1m_final_vs_only.json
commands.full_pipeline: uv run python scripts/benchmark_pipelines.py --suite full --repeat 1 --profile-mode audit --output benchmark_results/work_amplification/2026-08-25-r3/pipelines_full_final.json
